rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for the edible codlike fish, although it can also refer more broadly to cod and related fish.

example.english: This ling tastes great when pan-fried until fragrant.
example.traditional: 呢條鱈魚煎香啲食，味道好正。
